statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies
